name: Support ticket triage with approval
description: Classifies a ticket with a model-driven router, drafts the right reply per branch, and waits for a human before sending.

branches.label: refund
branches.when: the customer wants money back, a refund, or a chargeback

branches.label: bug
branches.when: something is broken, crashing, or not working as expected

branches.label: question
branches.when: a how-to or general question with no money or breakage involved

config.system_prompt: You are a calm support agent. Policy: refunds within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked; after that, offer store credit.
You are a support engineer. Be concrete.
You are a friendly support agent.
